data_fields.name: item_footprint_w_h
data_fields.donor_constant: InventorySizeX / InventorySizeY per item type (values not read)

best_idea: Give each item a w x h cell footprint and place it first-fit in a row-major scan with a half-open overlap test, and make a multi-item add all-or-nothing.
decision_why: Take the footprint grid, first-fit scan and overlap test; fix the donor's flush-placement refusal (>= in the overlap test), its pixel-based bounds, and its non-atomic batch add in the sketch; reject the gold-panel stub as written because its typed amount is not bounded.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a 2x1 item fits flush against a 1x1 at its right without a gap; a placement past the last column is refused; a batch of three items into a pack with two free cells places none and leaves the pack list identical to before.
